effect.name: GM Pro Wave
effect.desc: A layered wave warp. Seven waveforms - sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, noise, damped ripple and flag - can be stacked up to four harmonics deep with a decay between them, so the wave is never a plain sine. The displacement direction is separate from the phase direction: horizontal, vertical, radial, angular or diagonal, with the diagonal angle as its own control. A cross wave on the other axis, turbulence, an edge taper and clamp/mirror/wrap sampling finish it. Built in layer space, so the wave runs through the layer's own pixels.
